rows.reply_en:
Dear,

To swap a shift, open the shift in the app and tap "Ruil aanbieden" (Offer swap). Colleagues with the same role can then accept the swap. The manager approves it under Rooster → Verzoeken (Rota → Requests). The manager can optionally turn off this approval under Instellingen → Rooster (Settings → Rota).

Best regards,
Team Roosterly
